preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10.
The number of ladders n and snakes m must each be between 1 and 15.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= start <= 100 and 1 <= end <= 100 for start, end in ladders + snakes)
preconditions.description: All ladder and snake start and end positions must be valid board squares between 1 and 100.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of rolls required to reach square 100, or -1 if no solution exists.
